content: Fowler event sourcing (https://www.martinfowler.com/eaaDev/EventSourcing.html) identifies external query results and repeated external effects as replay hazards. Temporal (https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-definition) requires deterministic command history. Tapestry should record materialized external outcomes and disable effect dispatch during replay; immutable branch prefixes and snapshots require explicit execution-version identity.
